title: Livia Mini Dress
description: The Livia Mini Dress is soft, sweet and a little bit nostalgic. Crafted from a lightweight fabric in a buttery yellow tone scattered with delicate blue florals, it carries a quiet, garden-fresh charm. The colour feels warm and gentle, like early summer light through a window. A sweetheart neckline frames the bust, held by slim spaghetti straps that sit cleanly on the shoulders. The fitted bodice nips in at the waist before flaring into a full, playful skirt that swings beautifully with every step. For brunch dates, garden parties and the kind of slow afternoons that feel like the start of something good.

A sequin dress that does the job of shapewear and a formal dress at once.
